system.note: Demo stand-in. Northwind OData V4 tables play the role of Dataverse tables.

findings.policy: POL-PII-004 Date of birth must be masked outside HR
findings.description: BirthDate is replicated unmasked to the Lakehouse and exposed to the HR Agent knowledge source.
findings.recommendedAction: Apply dynamic masking to BirthDate in Lakehouse silver layer; remove column from agent knowledge index.

findings.policy: POL-SPECIAL-001 Special category data must not reside in free text
findings.description: Classifier detected health-related terms in the Notes column (2 of 9 rows).
findings.recommendedAction: Review flagged rows with HR; move content to a controlled HR system or redact.

findings.policy: POL-AI-002 PII must be masked before use by AI agents
findings.description: ContactName and Phone are returned unmasked by the 'Sales 360' Power BI dataset consumed by a Copilot agent.
findings.recommendedAction: Create a masked view (contacts_masked) and re-point the agent tool to it.

findings.policy: DQ-ORD-010 Shipped orders must have a ShippedDate
findings.description: 21 orders have a null ShippedDate more than 30 days after OrderDate.
findings.recommendedAction: Backfill from carrier confirmations; add validation rule in Dynamics.

findings.policy: POL-ACCESS-003 Least-privilege access to contact data
findings.description: Supplier contact phone numbers are readable by the 'All Employees' security role.
findings.recommendedAction: Restrict column-level security to Procurement role.

findings.description: Ship-to addresses older than retention window were present in the bronze layer.

findings.policy: DQ-CUST-003 Region must be populated for NA customers
findings.description: Region is null for 60 of 91 customers, including 4 in the USA and Canada.
findings.recommendedAction: Populate Region via address standardization service.
